messages:
lee: Opening a small PR that stitches together a python + curl example for quota tier selection and the updated dashboard link. Wanted to surface a few migration quirks we should document.

priya: Solid. Can you paste both snippets here so I can double-check header names and response examples?

lee: Sure. Python snippet (requests):

lee: ```py
# choose_tier_py.py
import requests
resp = requests.post(
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate',
  json={'model':'redwood-llama-3','input':'Explain SLOs'},
  headers={
    'Authorization': 'Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY',
    'X-Redwood-Tier': 'org:enterprise',   # prefer org-level tier
    'X-Redwood-Fallback': 'economy'      # allow cheaper fallback if needed
  }
)
print(resp.json())
```

tom: Can we also include a curl one-liner? Some customers paste that straight into terminal.

lee: Yep: 

lee: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "X-Redwood-Tier: org:enterprise" \n  -H "X-Redwood-Fallback: economy" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-llama-3","input":"Explain SLOs"}'
```

priya: Two notes: (1) call out that header names are case-insensitive and accepted as either hyphenated or underscore on some SDKs; (2) include the example of what the quota/usage payload looks like in the analytics export.

lee: Added a minimal analytics payload example to show meter keys and the new field naming:

lee: ```json
{
  "usage": [
    {"meter":"tokens","usage_tier":"enterprise","count":9421},
    {"meter":"requests","usage_tier":"enterprise","count":21},
    {"meter":"burst_credits","usage_tier":"legacy-grant","count":50}  
  ]
}
```

tom: Good. We should explicitly document that legacy burst credits are surfaced on the quota API as a transient object named "graceAllowance" and that the dashboard panel id changed. PM asked for the exact panel link to paste into setup emails.

lee: Panel link (templated): https://console.redwood.ai/dashboard/quota_v3_panel?org={{org_id}}. Note: this view requires console:quota-read role. I'll add that callout.

priya: Also add a short troubleshooting bullet: if customers see meters labeled "legacy-grant", they need to run the migration tool to consolidate allowances; include the CLI command and link.

lee: What wording do you want for the CLI? I added: 

lee: ```bash
# consolidate legacy burst credits into new tier mapping
redwood-cli migrate-quotas --org $ORG_ID --dry-run
```

docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4987 reviewers: @priya @tom

billing-bot: FYI billing schema changed: "tier_label" -> "usage_tier" as of 2026-01-05. Finance notified.

priya: I'll do a pass on wording (keep it simple) and add the panel link to the onboarding template.

lee: Thanks — I'll squash the commits after CI and update the analytics reference to include the usage_tier example.

tom: LGTM once docs pass linter. If finance needs tweaks, we'll coordinate in the PR.

lee: pinging when merged. :shipit:
